name: tab-nav
title: TabNav
description: Page-level tabs where each tab is its own URL. Not for switching panels in place; that is Tabs (not in the system yet).
docs: Ejected from @macaw-ds/ui@0.0.0. Each tab is a URL. Use TabNav only when the sections are separate pages or routes. Exactly one item is active, and it matches the current route.

manifest.name: TabNav
manifest.purpose: Page-level tabs where each tab is its own URL. Not for switching panels in place; that is Tabs (not in the system yet).
manifest.description: Navigation tabs for the sections of a page: Overview, Usage, Accessibility, Code. Each item is a link, so tabs can be bookmarked, shared and opened in a new tab. The current tab sets aria-current="page". Usually rendered by PageHeader's tabs slot.

aria-label.description: Names the navigation landmark, e.g. "Invoice sections".
aria-label.a11y: Required: pages often have several nav landmarks.

asChild.description: On TabNav.Item: render a router Link instead of an anchor.

a11y.role: navigation, containing a list of links
keyboard: Tab: move between tabs (each is a link)
a11y.name: The navigation landmark takes its name from aria-label; each tab from its text.
notes: Navigation tabs are links, not role="tab". Arrow keys are not used; that pattern belongs to in-page Tabs.
The selected tab is marked with aria-current="page", and the underline is not the only signal: the text colour changes too.
The list never scrolls horizontally, so the 2px focus ring is never clipped; keep to six short labels.

motion.description: Underline and text colour ease on hover.

rules: Each tab is a URL. Use TabNav only when the sections are separate pages or routes.
Exactly one item is active, and it matches the current route.
Keep labels to one or two words; four to six tabs at most.
With a router, pass the Link through asChild so client-side navigation keeps working.
dos: Place TabNav in PageHeader's tabs slot so it sits under the page title and sticks below the TopBar.
donts: Do not use TabNav to swap panels without changing the URL.
Do not nest TabNav inside a Card.
